Junk removal · Lowell, MA

Junk removal and cleanouts, done fast and left clean

We haul away furniture, appliances and debris from homes and businesses within 25 miles of Lowell, MA and southern New Hampshire — and sweep up before we leave.

Get a free quote Call (954) 245-1566

Our crew does all the lifting and loading with our own truck. We handle single items, full rooms and complete property cleanouts, and we leave the space broom-clean and ready to use.

Since we are a cleaning company, we can follow the cleanout with a deep clean of the space — perfect for move-outs, rentals and properties getting ready for sale.

Frequently asked questions

How is junk removal priced?

Price depends on the volume, weight and type of items. Send us a few photos and we will give you a free quote.

Do you do the lifting?

Yes. Our crew does all the lifting, loading and hauling — you just point to what goes.

What do you do with the items?

We donate or recycle what we can and dispose of the rest responsibly at approved facilities.

Service area: about 25 miles around Lowell, MA

We serve homes and businesses in Lowell, Dracut, Chelmsford, Tewksbury, Billerica, Westford, Tyngsborough, Lawrence, Methuen, Andover, North Andover, Haverhill, Wilmington, Burlington, Woburn, Bedford, Acton, Littleton in Massachusetts, plus Nashua, Hudson, Salem, Pelham, Windham, Londonderry, Derry, Merrimack in southern New Hampshire.
